# Xiluet Smiles

> Cosmetic dentistry clinic in Miami, Florida (Westchester, on Calle Ocho, 15 minutes from Miami International Airport). Porcelain veneers, smile makeovers, full mouth reconstruction and All-on-X dental implants with an in-house ceramic lab, delivered in one week. Published prices, free photo evaluation, 5-year written warranty. English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Name: Xiluet Smiles (Xiluet Smile Design)
- Address: 8396 SW 8th St, 2nd Floor, Miami, FL 33144, United States
- Phone: +1 (305) 615-5500 (call, text or WhatsApp)
- Email: hello@xiluetsmiledesign.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Eastern)
- Google rating: 5.0 from 251 reviews
- Doctors: Dr. Gretell Alonso Fiel, DMD (veneers and smile design); Dr. Marta Puentes Marrero, DMD (restorative and cosmetic); Dr. Roger Ramos Navarro, DMD (implants, endodontics, full mouth)
- Lab: in-house ceramic lab, doctor and ceramist in the same building
- Material: zirconia and porcelain restorations, minimal-prep veneers as thin as 0.3 mm
- Free photo evaluation: send photos online, a doctor replies with a treatment plan within 6 hours; written estimate included
- Financing: Cherry, Sunbit, CareCredit, LendingClub, Alphaeon Credit

## Treatments and published prices (USD)

- [Smile Design, 20 porcelain veneers, $6,999](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/smile-design-miami)
- [Smile Makeover, 20 porcelain crowns or veneers with whitening and gum contouring when needed, $7,999](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/smile-makeover-miami)
- [Full Mouth Reconstruction, $10,000](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/full-mouth-reconstruction-miami)
- [All-on-X Fixed Arches, $10,000 per arch](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/all-on-x-dental-implants-miami)
- [Digital smile design process](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/smile-design-miami)
- [Veneers cost in Miami, full price list](https://xiluetsmiledesign.com/veneers-cost-miami)

All packages include a professional cleaning and X-rays. Deep cleaning, extractions, bone grafts and other procedures are quoted separately in writing.
